candidate.answerReason: The three inner values are -1, 1, and -3. Substituting them into the outer operation gives -1 divided by 4, with every denominator nonzero.

methods.label: Evaluate from the inside outward
methods.explanation:
First evaluate the three inner operations using the given rule:
\[
\begin{aligned}
\diamond(1,2,3)&=\frac{1}{2-3}=-1,\\
\diamond(2,3,1)&=\frac{2}{3-1}=1,\\
\diamond(3,1,2)&=\frac{3}{1-2}=-3.
\end{aligned}
\]
Their denominators are \(-1\), \(2\), and \(-1\), so all three are defined. These results become the ordered inputs of the outer operation:
\[
\diamond(-1,1,-3)
=\frac{-1}{1-(-3)}
=\frac{-1}{4}
=-\frac14.
\]
The outer denominator is also nonzero. The answer is \(\boxed{-\frac14}\), choice \(\text{B}\).
